SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(CAST(remeddue AS DATE), 'Month') AS month, 
    AVG(riskassess) AS average_severity, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(riskassess) DESC) AS severity_rank 
FROM 
    AuditAndCompliance AS a 
JOIN 
    RiskManagement AS r ON a.recordregistry = r.recordregistry 
WHERE 
    remedstate ILIKE 'Completed' 
GROUP BY 
    month 
ORDER BY 
    severity_rank;

WITH audit_severity AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', remeddue) AS audit_month, 
        critfindnum * 1.0 / findtally AS avg_severity
    FROM 
        auditandcompliance
    WHERE 
        findtally > 0 
),
ranked_severity AS (
    SELECT 
        audit_month, 
        avg_severity, 
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_severity DESC) AS severity_rank
    FROM 
        audit_severity
)
SELECT 
    audit_month, 
    avg_severity, 
    severity_rank
FROM 
    ranked_severity
ORDER BY 
    severity_rank;

f36f159d44ae4b3dd52c66bbcafe300569b2bf8a.sql:
WITH security_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.profiletrace,
        dp.volgb,
        dp.datasense,
        sp.encstate,
        sp.aclstate,
        -- Calculate DSI and SRS
        (dp.volgb * CASE dp.datasense WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS dsi,
        (
            CASE sp.encstate 
                WHEN 'Full' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Partial' THEN 2
                ELSE 1
            END * 
            CASE sp.aclstate 
                WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2
                ELSE 1
            END
        ) AS srs
    FROM 
        dataprofile dp
    JOIN 
        securityprofile sp ON dp.profiletrace = sp.profilekey
)
-- Update API security state to 'Review Required' for profiles with potential security issues
UPDATE securityprofile sp
SET apisecstate = 'Review Required'
FROM security_issues si
WHERE 
    sp.profilekey = si.profiletrace AND 
    si.dsi > 100 AND 
    si.srs < 2;

-- Return the updated details for these profiles
SELECT 
    dp.profiletrace,
    dp.volgb,
    dp.datasense,
    sp.encstate,
    sp.aclstate,
    sp.apisecstate
FROM 
    dataprofile dp
JOIN 
    securityprofile sp ON dp.profiletrace = sp.profilekey
WHERE 
    (dp.volgb * CASE dp.datasense WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) > 100 AND 
    (
        CASE sp.encstate 
            WHEN 'Full' THEN 3
            WHEN 'Partial' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END * 
        CASE sp.aclstate 
            WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3
            WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END
    ) < 2;
